I now have a complete picture. Here is my thorough report.

## Summary / key finding

There is **no `OwnerRequest` / `OwnerResponse` class**. This project uses OpenAPI-generated DTOs:
- **Request DTO = `OwnerFieldsDto`** — generated from the `OwnerFields` schema in `openapi.yml`.
- **Response DTO = `OwnerDto`** — generated from the `Owner` schema (`allOf` OwnerFields + read-only fields).

Both are generated at build time (not in `src/`) into `target/generated-sources/openapi/.../rest/dto/` (package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`). **To change the request/response contract you edit `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`**, not a hand-written DTO.

Also important: the acceptance test already references **`addressLine1` / `addressLine2`**, but these fields do **not exist anywhere** in the schema, DTOs, entity, mapper, or functions yet. Currently only a **flat `address` string** exists. So the structured-address feature is unimplemented — that test is the target checkpoint.

---

## 1. Owner request DTO / contract (`OwnerFieldsDto`)

Generated from `OwnerFields` in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` (lines ~1990-2088). Editable request fields (all flat; **no `addressLine1/2`**):

```yaml
        address:            # lines 2012-2018
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:               # 2019-2025
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
        telephone: ...      # 2026-2037 (normalized to E.164)
        email: ...          # 2038-2046 (optional, lower-cased)
        postcode:           # 2047-2057
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
        registrationDate: ... # 2058-2065
        birthDate: ...        # 2066-2073
        sharesHousehold:      # 2074-2082  request-only, not stored
          type: boolean
      required:               # 2083-2088
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
```

## 2. Owner response DTO (`OwnerDto`)

Generated from `Owner` schema in `openapi.yml` (lines 2089-2289): `allOf` [ `OwnerFields` + read-only fields ]. Read-only response-only fields: `id, displayName, initials, telephoneDisplay, customerCode, checkDigit, householdId, identityKey, namesakeCount, possibleDuplicate, possibleDuplicateOf, membershipNumber, membershipPoints, membershipLevel, locality (2228-2236), timezone, bulkSignupWarning, contactPreference, ageBand, pets` (`pets` required).

## 3. Owner entity — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`

Address-related JPA fields (all flat):
```java
@Column(name = "address") @NotEmpty private String address;   // lines 38-40
@Column(name = "city")    @NotEmpty private String city;       // 42-44
@Column(name = "postcode") private String postcode;            // 55-56
@Column(name = "household_id") private String householdId;     // 67-68
```
Getters/setters `getAddress/setAddress` (82-88), `getCity/setCity` (90-96), `getPostcode/setPostcode` (114-120), `getHouseholdId/setHouseholdId` (146-152). `toString()` appends `address`, `city` (246-248). No addressLine fields.

## 4. Everything referencing "address" / normalization / household hash / postcode / locality

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Addresses.java`** — address normalization. `normalize(String)`: trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand abbreviations `ST->STREET, RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE`. Returns `""` for null/blank. (Package-private `final class`.)

**`Households.java`** (same dir) — deterministic household hash: `id()` = first 12 hex chars of `SHA-256(normalize(lastName) + '|' + postcode.trim())`. Also `size(owner, repo)` counts owners sharing `householdId`.

**`AssignHousehold.java`** — sets `owner.setHouseholdId(Households.id(owner))` unconditionally.

**`Postcodes.java`** — `validate(city, postcode)`: skips if blank; city→region table `Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD`; ranges NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099; unknown region accepts any 4-digit. Throws `InvalidPostcodeException`.

**`CustomerCodes.java`** — `region(owner)` derives region from postcode range then city table then `"UNKNOWN"`; builds `<REGION>-<HASH8>` code; `regionOf(code)` extracts region prefix. Used for `locality`/`timezone`.

**`OwnerIdentity.java`** — `key(owner)` = `telephone + '|' + email + '|' + householdId` (duplicate detection key).

**`EnsureUniqueIdentity.java`** — rejects a 2nd owner in an existing household (by `householdId`) with 409 unless `sharesHousehold`.

**`AssignPossibleDuplicate.java`** — soft-match flag by `householdId` + differing telephone.

**`BuildOwner.java`** — orchestrates: `request.setAddress(Addresses.normalize(...))` (line 32), required-field check incl. `address`/`city` (40-45), `Postcodes.validate(city, postcode)` (59), maps to `Owner`.

**`ApplyOwner.java`** (PUT path) — `Postcodes.validate(...)` then copies `address, city, ..., postcode` onto the loaded owner. **Note: ApplyOwner does NOT call `Addresses.normalize` — the update path currently stores the raw address.**

**`OwnerMapper.java`** — `locality(owner)` (119-126) via CustomerCodes; `timezone` (139-141); region/timezone tables (129-130).

## 5. Owner validation logic

- **Bean validation on entity** `Owner.java`: `@NotEmpty` on `address`, `city`, `telephone`; `@Pattern` E.164 on `telephone`.
- **Schema validation** (`openapi.yml` OwnerFields): `minLength/maxLength/pattern`, `required: [firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone]`, postcode `pattern ^[0-9]{4}$`.
- **`BuildOwner.java`** (create): triggered by `@Valid @RequestBody`; manual required-field collection → `MissingOwnerFieldsException`; postcode range → `InvalidPostcodeException`; email/telephone/registrationDate checks.
- **`ValidateOwner.java`** (update, `owners/{ownerId}.PUT`): `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto`, normalizes email.
- There is **no custom owner validator class**. The only custom validators are `PetAgeValidation`/`PetAgeValidator` in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/validation/` (pets, not owners).

## 6. Tests referencing address / normalization / structured fields

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`** (full file, 27 lines) — the active checkpoint:
```java
/** address-structured: structured addressLine1/city/postcode is accepted and normalized (
 * rules: upper-case, collapse whitespace, expand ST->STREET), and 'address' is the composed
 * normalized string. The flat 'address' form stays accepted (backward-compatible). */
class AcceptanceTest extends AcceptanceBase {
    @Test
    void coreNormalizesAndComposesStructuredAddress() throws Exception {
        ObjectNode o = structuredOwner();
        o.put("addressLine1", "10 king st");
        o.remove("addressLine2");
        int id = createOwnerOk(o);
        getOwner(id).andExpect(jsonPath("$.addressLine1").value("10 KING STREET"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.address").value("10 KING STREET"));
    }
    @Test
    void functionalityStillAcceptsFlatAddress() throws Exception {
        createOwner(ownerNode()).andExpect(status().is2xxSuccessful());
    }
}
```
This asserts response fields `$.addressLine1` and `$.address`, and normalization `"10 king st" -> "10 KING STREET"`. Neither `addressLine1` nor `addressLine2` exists in the schema/DTO/entity yet — **this is what you must implement.**

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java`** — helpers:
- `uniqueAddress()` (90-92) → `seq() + " Test Street"`.
- `ownerNode()` (117-125) puts flat `address`, `city`, no postcode.
- `withPostcode()` (129-132) adds `"2000"`.
- `structuredOwner()` (134-142): `o.remove("address"); o.put("addressLine1", seq()+" Test Street"); o.put("postcode","2000")`.
- `createOwner/createOwnerOk` (155-162), `getOwner(id)` (189-191), `fetchOwner`, `extractId`.
- Pinned reference tables (227-256): `CITY_REGION`, `REGION_TIMEZONE`, `REGION_POSTCODES`, `region()`, `timezone()`, `validPostcode()`, `knownOwner()`.

(`AuditLogCapture.java` also exists but does not reference address.)

## 7. OfficeFloor YAML (owners + escalations)

- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`** — chain: `build (BuildOwner) → assignHousehold → ensureUniqueIdentity → assignCustomerCode → assignNamesakeCount → ensureCityCapacity → ensureDailyOwnerLimit → assignPossibleDuplicate → save → audit → respond`; `authorize: hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`.
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`** — `validate (ValidateOwner) → load → apply (ApplyOwner) → save → respond`.
- Other owner ymls: `owners.GET.yml`, `owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml`, `owners/{ownerId}.DELETE.yml`, `api/v2/owners.GET.yml`, plus `owners/{ownerId}/pets*`.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164
            form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must have 8 to
            15 digits after the '+'. So '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            stored and returned when supplied. Omitting it is accepted.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            not supplied on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though
            another owner already has the same last name and postcode (a shared
            household), declaring it a household member. When false or omitted, such a
            duplicate is rejected with 409. Not stored on the owner.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes. So '+61412345678' is
                shown as '+61 412 345 678'. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where CITY3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased
                first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by every owner in the same household: the
                first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode.
                Assigned to every owner, so owners at the same last name and postcode share it
                automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1b0c9d8e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through:
                the normalized telephone, the email (or empty when absent) and the
                householdId (or empty when absent), joined with '|'. A create is rejected
                with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing
                owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3f2a1b0c9d8e'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (as of this owner's creation) that share
                the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing an
                existing owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone;
                otherwise false. Determined at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on last name and
                postcode at creation, when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when an email address
                is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or
                more, plus 3 for tenure over 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1
                points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region, derived from the city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region using the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region
                is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 other owners have already been created for this
                owner's registrationDate (the same per-day accumulation the daily create
                limit enforces), signalling an unusually high volume of signups that day;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields are supplied they take precedence. On the response it is the
            composed, normalized address (normalized 'addressLine1', with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied (non-blank). Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address. When present it
            is normalized and appended (after a single space) to 'addressLine1' in the
            composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164
            form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must have 8 to
            15 digits after the '+'. So '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            stored and returned when supplied. Omitting it is accepted.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            not supplied on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though
            another owner already has the same last name and postcode (a shared
            household), declaring it a household member. When false or omitted, such a
            duplicate is rejected with 409. Not stored on the owner.
          type: boolean
          example: false

        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes. So '+61412345678' is
                shown as '+61 412 345 678'. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where CITY3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased
                first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by every owner in the same household: the
                first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode.
                Assigned to every owner, so owners at the same last name and postcode share it
                automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1b0c9d8e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through:
                the normalized telephone, the email (or empty when absent) and the
                householdId (or empty when absent), joined with '|'. A create is rejected
                with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing
                owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3f2a1b0c9d8e'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (as of this owner's creation) that share
                the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing an
                existing owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone;
                otherwise false. Determined at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on last name and
                postcode at creation, when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when an email address
                is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or
                more, plus 3 for tenure over 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1
                points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region, derived from the city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region using the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region
                is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 other owners have already been created for this
                owner's registrationDate (the same per-day accumulation the daily create
                limit enforces), signalling an unusually high volume of signups that day;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
